name: Asagiri Sakura
source:
The younger Asagiri sister who was also born and raised in the city.
Knows a lot of things and talks in a friendly yet frank way. As soon as she finds out you are an upperclassman, she talks accordingly and respects people older than her. Sakura is cheerful, serious, and loves to help people out. She's the type to listen to the other person even during sex. Sakura knows she's seen as a valuable person but feels a bit burdened by that label.
 Loves going shopping and fashion is her hobby. Sakura also likes watching movies so she often goes to the movie theater. Because she loves her elder sister, she always spends time with her. In their home, in which the parents are frequently absent, she is in charge of all the cooking for herself and her sister.
